about_the_game:
When the body of River Garcia washes ashore in Clearwater Bay, the police quickly rule it a suicide, but something doesn’t sit right with her grieving parents.

As Detective Alex Hill, you’ve been to hired investigate the mysterious retreat center where River lived. Inside its isolated walls, you'll meet its secretive members and unravel the dark mysteries of the group. The more you dig, the more you realize that nothing is as it seems, and everyone has something to hide

Is River’s death truly a tragic suicide, or was it orchestrated by someone with sinister intentions? Solve puzzles, look for evidence, and confront a web of lies as you work to uncover the truth.

Features:

◘ Solve puzzles and interrogate suspects

◘ Find clues as you uncover the dark secrets of Clearwater Bay

◘ Enjoy a classic point-and-click adventure

◘ Fully voice acted

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Monterey 12.0 or later, Metal 2.4 capable
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 dual core or M1 and newer
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 460
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Monterey 12.0 or later, Metal 2.4 capable
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 quad core or better or M1 and newer
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 560 or better
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: CPU AMD-FX-6300 or Intel Core i3-4xxx
  • Memory: 6 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 TI or AMD Radeon R7 370
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.00 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 1050 TI or AMD Radeon RX 470

short_description: When a body mysteriously washes up on the shores of Clearwater Bay, you, as Detective Alex Hill, are hired to investigate. Was it a tragic suicide or is something more sinister at work? Solve puzzles, look for evidence, and confront a web of lies as you work to uncover the truth.
